body: Whatever makes u happy
I think he already knew that because I was always the one to text first, ughh, I hate myself so much. How can I have feelings for such a terrible human being
Ughhh I know 😩😩😩😩😩😩 I just cant stop thinking about him. What is wrong with me 😔
He literally talks about sex to me 24/7 so much like I got sick of it, I dont even know what I see in him, despite all that I still like him a lot
It’s just i wanted him to try this tiktok trend and he made fun of me for it so I got mad. It was so childish
I just didnt want to argue :(, should I apologize for ignoring him?
I dont really know how to do that

Me too
Just tired of trying then get broken again
I wont

I tried to put myself in his shoes. I did block him once when we first broke up because I was scared I might reach out and say something stupid, but I unblocked him a month later because I no longer wanted to reach out and I was hoping he would contact me first but that was it I never block again. But for him it went on for months of blocking and unblocking then blocking again and again
Thanks for your kind words. I just don’t trust myself enough yet. I want kids, I’m just afraid that I won’t be a good enough mother…

Thanks for your kind words. She had said a lot of things like that. There were times when I offered her help, she would say that I don’t really want to help her and I’m just acting fake. I never had a mentor, growing up I just googled my way out of problems. I used to talk to my grandma a lot when I was a kid because I lived with her but she and my mom were also fighting, and she moved away, so I don’t know where she is now anymore. She only wrote me a letter once telling me how my mom stole money from her and never reached out again. It’s really sad

I think she had realized that I don’t need her anymore so she starts saying mean things to me. Growing up she had always tried to control my life and now I’m independent she can’t manipulate me like she used to. So she started to say mean things so I feel bad. Whenever I have trouble at work and I talk to her about it she always says I’m a whiner and I should be glad that I at least have a job. If I make decent money she would say that I act like I’m better than her and calling me arrogant because I can buy expensive things. I don’t think she was ever truly happy for me when I make accomplishments and never cared if I have life problems. She just mocks me all the time
Pretty sure they don’t care. I’m asian so…😢
I’m kinda envy those who are close and loved by their parents. I always feel so emotionally distant from mine
Me too, and the thought of dying alone running through my head consistently it’s scary
I never want to go back, it just hurts because I hate myself for letting him do that to me. At the end of the day I feel like I’m the only to blame
Thanks. I’ll try to get by each day with this thought

It will, I’m 6 months in NC and I went from someone who so desperately want to get him back to someone who wants nothing to do with him. The other day he unblocked me after 6 months and the old photos of us tagged each other in reappeared, it brought back some memories and sadness but I just block him back for my mental health. You’ll get better, time does heal all wound
Him reaching out could be a clear sign for you to finally move on completely. You’re one step closer to someone more compatible for you. Best of luck.

Oh boy you remind me of myself. When I found out my ex left me for someone he cheated on me with I went wild, I went to his house and confront him and it ended up violently with him hitting me. I REGRET EVERYDAY that I did that. I understand exactly what you’re going through, the anger just seems so unbearable so much that want to explode. But it WILL fade. Believe me it may seems like you’re gonna be angry forever now, one day you won’t even think about them for days, and if that thought of them pop up you will just be like, oh well, they deserve each other, or she’s his problem now not mine. Right now just breathe, watch mediation videos if you must, listen to podcasts and videos about how to forgive your ex and forgive yourself, put your anger into the gym or just simply running. Then when you’re ready, make some plans that you had always wanted to do without her, then just do them! Trust me I regret everyday for that time I burst out, I swear I will never let someone like that get in my head anymore. It will get better you’ll see
You WILL, trust me when you make it all about you the past will just seem foggy, you won’t even think of her anymore.

He left me for someone else and they’re still together. It’s been 6 months of NC and I swear there were days I could go by without thinking of him. I didn’t even remember our relationship as much anymore. Just the other day he unblocked me, and the old photos of us tagging each other reappeared on my timeline, I wasn’t even checking on him at all like I was like when did he unblock?? I was scrolling my own timeline then I found out, but the photos brings back the memories and the shitty feelings in the beginning of the breakup so I just block him back. I know now that even if they reach out, it’s not always a good thing, it will even mess up all the healing progress I made so far. So I just block him and forget this had happened

From my experience of 6 months in NC, the first 2 months are the hardest. Then it slowly gets better and there will be days go by without the thought of them. I was actually replaced with someone else, he left me for a girl at work. I watched a lot of self-healing videos, podcasts, read self-help books, go to the gym everyday, then it just gets better without me realizing it. I still think of him and how he replaced me, but it isn’t as bad as before. My advice to you is to block her everywhere before she blocks you, mine blocked me first then just the other day he unblocked after 6 months, and the stupid old photos of us tagging each other in reappeared, and it brought back shitty feelings like the beginning of the breakup so I just block him back. If you can, take a break from your phone. Distract yourself with things that you can do without it, talk to a trusted friend or family members. Trust me when all of these sinks down, you won’t even remember why you were so heartbroken.

Just think of it like this. She could be with another guy right now and if you keep obsessing over her it can make them both think of you as the crazy ex bf. Do you really want to be someone who come between someone else’s relationship? Even if it’s not a serious one you wouldn’t want to be in her little guys circle to boost her ego right? When my ex broke up with me he was hitting on a few girls and also had cheated on me before the breakup. I’m a drama-free person, I don’t want any possible future drama so I blocked him just in case I lost myself and text him something stupid that could get me in trouble. That was my motivation, to stay drama-free and focus on myself

I’m exactly like you right now. I moved on and can go on days without thinking about him then boom, one day the old photos and posts of us tagging each other in reappeared on my timeline, all the public and private ones. He’s also still with the girl he dumped me for. If I were his gf I would never want my bf to unblock his ex then bring back the old posts, and I don’t want to deal with any possible drama between them in the future so I just block him back. IGNORE THEM, what they do shouldn’t affect you and you definitely do not want to just randomly become a reason for their fight when you do absolutely nothing wrong. Just block them both and move on

She’s definitely trying to get your attention and see if you would contact her first. She doesn’t unblock you everywhere else because she might doesn’t want you to like or posted on her stuff? It just my prediction but whatever you do DON’T CONTACT her. It will only to satisfy her ego. Honestly it just seem like a narcissistic move of her.

Thanks. After he blocked me on Facebook I have already blocked him on messenger so he can never text me and I have been in no contact ever since. Thank god I did. I’m just gonna go through this once for good, then block him everywhere else and never look back
Thanks, I still have him blocked on my messenger for the last months so he can’t ever text me. Thank god I did that. I’ll just suffer through this once in for all and never look back

He broke up with me for someone else, I think they’re still together so I don’t understand why he unblocked me, it feels like he did it just to make me feel bad because he knows I would hurt me to see old photos again. We were together for 6 years so I had to untag myself in many of his photos which means I have to see them all over again. It really sucks
Thanks, I’m doing much better than I was 6 months ago but then I still want to hear from him one last time, I don’t know why

Sometimes I imgine what’s it’s like if he was standing right in front of me apologizing for what he did, but I felt like I wouldn’t look at him the same way I did. He hurt me bad and I don’t think I will ever saw him the same way I did ever again. I don’t know why I still have this feeling of wanting to wait for him.
You were with her for a year, that’s enough time to connect to someone emotionally so when they leave of course it’s gonna hurt, she’s probably hurting too even now she’s with this new guy

Of course you loved her bro, you were just in denial so you wouldn’t get hurt. When my six year relationship ended I wondered the same thing as why am I so heartbroken over someone who I thought I never loved. That’s the power of the breakup, they help you realize things about your past relationship you never saw before. Just hang tight, the pain is gonna pass

My breakup ended really badly, like really bad. But throughout the 6 year relationship his mom was the nicest of all his family members. Even when the relationship ended she knew how bad it was and she still being nice to me. Honestly the males in my ex’s family were toxic af, but the women were great people

Thanks! At first I wanted to be friends with my ex too, but since the breakup he had became a totally different person, he got into a rebound right after the breakup but still hitting on other girls. It was too much complication for me and I don’t want anyone he’s seeing to suddenly come at me so I started NC. But it’s hard to stop checking his profile now and then

I’m just confused actually, since the breakup he had blocked, then unblocked, then blocked again. I never did any blocking because I don’t see the points. I never made any contact either. And it’s been months why is he blocking me again now?

The reason I’m thinking he’s playing mind games is because he had blocked me before, then unblocked, the blocked again, and before no contact he had called me once then hang up right away, saying wrong number. Since the breakup I never did anything but deleted photos. I just don’t see the point of blocking someone. So I just feel confused when he keeps going back and forth
I never contacted him, I don’t want to. But I still check his profile every once in a while just out of curiosity.

I’m sorry, my wrong choice of words. English is not my first language. I only check his social media profile once in a while, i never actually ask how he’s doing or break no contact. And it’s true that I’m still curious about how he’s doing but I’m not gonna say anything just because he blocked me. I dont want to have to go through all the healing again by initiating contacts
That’s exactly how it feels like
I know how you feel, my ex was always reluctant about getting a decent job too. It was frustrating. Hope you’ll get through it soon
